title: Laser Fan
description: Two stage projectors fan single-colour laser beams through drifting haze. Music opens, sways and strobes the fans; each projector aims at the hand on its side of Source B.

parameters.label: Sparkle
parameters.description: Bright points racing along the beams.

parameters.label: Strobe
parameters.description: Flash and snap of the fans on musical attacks.

parameters.label: Haze
parameters.description: Stage smoke that makes the beams visible.

parameters.label: Hand Aim
parameters.description: How strongly each projector follows the hand on its side.

provenance.prompt_summary: A concert laser fan from the stage floor: beams open with the bass, bend with the melody, sparkle with treble and fire along their length on attacks.
